steering_ledger.verbatim:
KERNELS / LOW-LEVEL
1. llama.cpp PR #32613: Q8_0 block interleaving for AVX-512/AVX2 (open). Reported: Zen 5 9600X, 6 threads, Llama-7B Q8_0 pp 73.65 -> 134.55 t/s (+82.7%), tg flat, PPL unchanged. New GEMV path is AVX2-only, so expect prefill-only gains on the EPYC 9655. Value: A/B candidate for the cpu-decode-roofline XFER-4b prefill row; check whether an AVX-512 GEMV path is worth writing ourselves.
2. llama.cpp PR #32505: CUDA/HIP duplicate expert IDs (merged 2026-11-19). Wave64-aware ggml_cuda_popc rewrite of the MUL_MAT_ID helper; removes the MMF variant that skipped the mmid helper. Reported +1-4% pp on MI100 (gfx908). Value: should build on gfx90a; assess rebase friction against our MUL_MAT_ID / C14 champion baseline and whether it changes MoE top-k dispatch.
3. llama.cpp PR #32266: HIP few-row MMQ on non-WMMA archs (draft). M=127, K=2048, N=9: Q8_0 74.6 -> 11.3 us, IQ4_XS 100.5 -> 8.4 us per call. Test GPU not named, so gfx90a coverage is unconfirmed. Value: this is exactly the spec-decode verify batch shape (DFlash2/MTP on MI210); verify CDNA2 applicability.
4. NariQ (arXiv 2611.26157) + Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF: trellis-coded PTQ calibrated on BF16 agent traces. Qwen3.8-27B at 3.0 bpw (10.1 GB) and 2.5 bpw match BF16 on DeepSWE / Terminal-Bench (41.6 and 40.7 vs 38.9 pass@1 DeepSWE). Needs the authors' llama.cpp fork, no AMD GPU support, slow CPU fallback. Value: agent-trace KL calibration for the EXL3 / low-bit lane (INF-80); trellis format relative to QTIP (intake-873); port cost to gfx90a/AVX-512.
5. RSIBench-Infra (arXiv 2611.24395): 20-task benchmark of agents optimizing real training/inference stacks at engine, kernel and instruction level; 66.2% of task results beat a validated 1.10x. NVIDIA + Ascend only. Value: its OCI-layer submission and independent re-evaluation protocol as a reference for AutoKernel custody / keep-gates.
6. ROCm 10.2.0 blog (2026-11-18): nothing new for gfx90a; prebuilt AITER covers MI300X/MI325X/MI350X/MI355X only. Value: look at the moat-cuda-to-rocm and FlyDSL agent skills as inputs to agentic kernel porting. Likely overlaps intake-2694 (ROCm 10.2 release notes); dedup accordingly. We stay on ROCm 6.2.

INFERENCE SYSTEMS / HARNESS / POST-TRAINING
7. NarrowSpec (arXiv 2611.23835): DFlash and EAGLE-3 drafters at 1/2 or 1/4 of target hidden width while largely keeping acceptance; for DFlash the output adapter folds into the borrowed vocab projection with logits unchanged. 1.06-1.12x on B200, 1.13-1.44x on GB10 at batch 1. Value: direct candidate for the DFlash2 lane (INF-50); a narrower drafter cuts draft cost on both CPU and MI210.
8. Quantized draft KV cache (arXiv 2611.20565): K4V4 with per-channel keys / per-token values cuts draft-cache memory 66.2%, mean acceptance 57.93% -> 57.14%. Value: contrasts with the DFlash quantized-draft-KV acceptance collapse in intake-1256 (llama.cpp #25725); the cache layout is the variable to test.
9. G-MTP (arXiv 2611.25813): shared MTP drafting head with target-activation injection, zero-copy KV cross-attention and clustered vocab projection; up to 3.1x server-side on Gemma 4, 2.3x on H100. Value: clustered vocab projection for Qwen3.8's 248K-vocab MTP head on CPU.
10. Budget Internalization (arXiv 2611.26172): RLVR with a fixed rollout cap teaches Qwen3.5-4B, Gemma4-E2B and Nemotron-3-Nano-4B to stop scaling past the training budget (ending below base at large budgets); stronger KL and less truncation preserve scaling. Value: guardrail for any local GRPO run feeding thinking-budget routing.
11. GrepMem (arXiv 2611.25123): append-only plain-text log + regex search tool, no embeddings or index; RL-trained Qwen3.5-9B 95-97% on ContextBench vs <=21% for lossy compaction baselines. Value: direct comparator for the orchestrator's ms.search / ms.expand trace tools and REPL compaction flags.
12. QDA (arXiv 2611.23388): agent designs per-model quantization recipes, scored in minutes by KL on held-out reasoning traces, with long-generation checks for repetition loops. Value: fits our KLD gates; could drive IQ4_XS / Q4_K_M recipe search on the EPYC.
13. FlashMorph2 (arXiv 2611.24809): on-policy layer selection for converting Qwen3 Transformers into full/linear-attention hybrids; +2.42 RULER, +1.08 LongBench over FlashMorph. Value: relevant to the hybrid-27B work (including the Expected-Attention "no safe ratio" finding); conversion is a post-training job, so assess cost before any adoption.
